name: surface-plot
description: A 3D surface z = f(x, y) over axes, shaded by height: a loss landscape, a density, a field. Use in an Episode3D.

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: the height function f(x, y), finite over the ranges

parameters.name: z_range
parameters.description: (low, high) of the z axis; default fits the surface

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: width and depth of the axes in scene units

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: height of the z axis in scene units

parameters.name: colors
parameters.description: theme colours shading the surface from low to high

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: patches along each side, 4 to 64; more is smoother and slower

returns: VGroup with .axes, .surface and .f; surface_point(plot, x, y), surface_path(plot, points) and downhill(plot, x, y) place things on it
